author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection silently hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: notCVE
text: Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-04: CVE-2024-27834 Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication (pointer authentication bypass), CVSS 8.8, public exploit.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Hackers breach at least 27 organizations using stolen Microsoft Entra ID application and Azure DevOps credentials in an ongoing cloud campaign.

author: techhelpcanada
text: Drupal Commerce sites face an actively exploited Commerce Core flaw. Patch to fixed releases and audit orders for payment or pricing anomalies.

author: f1tym1
text: JPCERT/CC has confirmed that a critical vulnerability in Airbyte is being actively exploited in the wild.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441)

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1): Unauthenticated RCE in WordPress core updater via race condition, actively exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV on November 3, 2026. Fixed in WordPress 7.1.4.

author: markgadala
text: Node.js announces upcoming security patches for high-severity vulnerabilities across three major versions.

author: veenodetech
text: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed around 1,411 flaws; one was exploited in real attacks: CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6: per AWS (CVE-2026-115415), prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade to 0.8.6 or remove the environment tool, then rotate keys.

author: baoge808
text: 98% of coding-agent sessions install archived, vulnerable MCP servers on their own (Glow Labs, MCPhantom). 17.3M npm downloads of packages with known RCE via prompt injection.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76893: tsParticles prior to 4.3.2, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server reuses one stateful transport...

author: lemma_oracle
text: A supply-chain attack: a LiteLLM release built from an attacker's fork shipped with a genuine signature, live on PyPI for 1 h 44 min (~49,000 downloads).

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Railway's preliminary report on the Oct 21 incident: up to about 100,000 workspaces (1.85%) may have had environment variables exposed. Railway says the attacker wanted AI and platform API keys. Rotate keys, then redeploy.

author: nyuszkoreal
text: mSecure urges users to rotate stored credentials, reset 2FA, and purge passkeys after a cloud breach.

author: XBToshi
text: The GitBook incident is a wake-up call: none of that matters if an attacker can compromise your documentation.

author: SiliconWireNews
text:
OpenAI says its AI found nearly 1,000 ways to get root on Linux.

In one run, an upcoming cyber model validated 948 kernel privilege-escalation bugs and wrote a patch for each. Total API bill: about $1.2M, or ~$1,279 per exploit. Update and reboot. #CyberSecurity @OpenAI https://t.co/6Gfko4Sx1z

author: RealFMH
text: CVE-2026-121234 (Critical, CVSS 9.6): privilege elevation in Contacts in Google Chrome on Android prior to 157.0.8103.38 could let a remote attacker execute code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page.

author: rootcausedev
text: CISA added two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to KEV after active exploitation: CVE-2026-111357 (missing auth) and CVE-2026-118527 (predictable identifiers). Patch now and keep management off the internet.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-122311 (CRITICAL, CVSS 9.9): Kyverno 1.16.0 before 1.19.2 has a path traversal weakness allowing namespaced CEL policies to escape their namespace.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Ruby on Rails 8.1.4.1 and 8.0.5.2 fix 21 vulnerabilities, one critical: CVE-2026-122006 (CVSS 9.8) in Active Storage with ImageMagick allows arbitrary file writes from crafted uploads; other issues enable RCE, file reads, XSS and DoS.

author: PopaRecon
text: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed it lost $130M+ in a Nov 4 cyberattack; attackers came in via a service provider's platform and used its account for fraudulent transfers. Client assets not affected.

author: Prince_Jain17
text: The two 9.2-severity PHP flaws (PHP2Shell) patched Oct 21 were uncovered by researchers at Calif working under OpenAI's Patch the Planet project alongside Wiz and Quarkslab; OpenAI organized a coalition for two months before the fix.

author: kkaasolutions
text: CVE-2026-97693 (CRITICAL 9.9): Yuxi, a large-model-based knowledge base and knowledge-graph agent development platform, from 0.6.0.beta1 is affected by a critical flaw.

author: for_N5R1
text:
echoleak is not one bug. it is four defenses falling in a row, each to a different trick.

the mail is written for a human, so the prompt injection filter waves it through. when the victim later asks copilot anything, retrieval pulls that mail into context, and its text starts https://t.co/FfhpE1o2Pa

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Neodyme published exploit details for two critical Puppet flaws (fixed by Perforce and OpenVox): CVE-2026-115731 lets crafted agent reports achieve server-side code execution, so a Puppet agent certificate can become a route to the fleet's management server.

author: chris_uk2026
text: Google's November 2026 Android update fixes 23 critical flaws, led by a zero-click RCE (CVE-2026-58868) and an 'SMS of Death' bug. Update devices now.

author: TheRawWire
text:
🚨 OpenAI says its AI found 948 Linux bugs that let any user take full root control.

And it wrote fixes for them.

~30 hours. ~$1,279 per bug. $1.2M total.

Why it matters: hacking and patching just became industrial. Every lab's security story now has a price per exploit. https://t.co/aNLOYBZhxr

author: theomlondhe
text: CVE-2026-109518: on Debian/Ubuntu, APT can install an attacker .deb as root after a verified download is overwritten through a hard link during HTTP retries. Fixed in apt 3.0.4; mitigate with Retries=0.

author: FatimaGulbaloch
text: CERT-In advisory on "CRAFTY FALCON", an AI-powered hacking group using publicly available AI pentest tools from GitHub such as PentAGI and ARTEX to attack targets.

author: BytesNora
text:
SecBoard Daily · 4 November 2026

8 topics on exploited flaws

Full daily briefing on SecBoard – address in the image.

author: CyfirmaR
text:
🚨 #PHP2Shell is being actively exploited.
#CVE2026109618 + #CVE2026109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated #RCE in #PHPcore. Updating your CMS does NOT fix it — the flaw is in #PHP itself. #CYFIRMA captured the attackers’ 216-host target list; attribution: #DPRK/#Lazarus-nexus, high

author: zoomeyebot
text: Google fixes a critical Skia use-after-free in Chrome on Android before 156.0.8078.47 (CVE-2026-113341).

author: unitxyz
text: GitBook has confirmed that the incident affecting Unit's documentation originated from a security breach of GitBook's infrastructure.

author: iamnrdas
text: Critical Kyverno CVE-2026-122310 (CVSS 9.9): namespace-scoped Policy creators can escalate to cluster admin via apiCall urlPath traversal in versions <1.19.2.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Zyxel has patched CVE-2026-107441, a pre-auth out-of-bounds write in GS1900 switches exploited as a zero-day. GreyNoise saw ~996 devices hit in 48 countries; Binarly found the June CVE-2026-7273 fix didn't stop it.

author: moftahlmabry
text: 948 ways to get root on Linux, found by AI in one run. OpenAI says a pipeline running an unreleased cyber model reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel bugs. It then built 948 distinct local privilege-escalation exploits, each with a candidate patch, for $1.21M in API credits.

author: xsociety_07
text: CISA says the WordPress core flaw (CVE-2026-119977) is actively exploited and added it to KEV on 3 Nov. CVSS 8.1, affects 4.7 to 7.1.3. Update to 7.1.4. Attack counts are attempts, not confirmed hacks. Sources: BleepingComputer, SOC Prime. https://t.co/Ui2T3Iu3l1
